subject: Promotion packet: evidence custody, redaction, and committee timing
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-02-20T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Promotion packet: evidence custody, redaction, and committee timing

Team —

I'm ready to hand over the promotion packet for Priya N. (IC, ML infra) to HR for final redaction and committee delivery. Before I send anything into the official intake folder I want to confirm a few operational points so we have a clear audit trail: 

- Custody: I currently have the raw artifacts (notebooks, PR links, demo video, and manager notes) consolidated as evidence_materials.zip. Preferred custody path? I can upload to the evidence Drive folder and mark the upload with a custody tag, or transfer via the secure SFTP we used last quarter.
- Redaction scope: Which items must be redacted prior to committee? I propose PII (names in call transcripts), customer identifiers, and any flagged screenshots. Work artifacts and PR diffs should remain intact.
- Redaction log: I will produce a redaction_log.csv listing original filename, redaction type, and redactor initials. Is that sufficient for SOC2 audit evidence?
- Committee timing: We need two possible 2-hour windows in the next committee cycle (week of Mar 1) so HR can slot Priya. Any strong conflicts I should watch for? Aditya — you mentioned a leadership offsite on Mar 2; want to confirm.

Attachments included here (stubs): evidence_materials.zip (contains: demo.mp4, notebook.ipynb, manager_notes.docx, transcripts.pdf)

Goal: get confirmation by end of day Monday so I can start the secure upload and the candidate consent flow.

Thanks,
Diego
Diego Fernandez
Manager, Model Serving
Redwood Inference

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-02-20T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Promotion packet: evidence custody, redaction, and committee timing

Diego — thanks for the heads up. A few quick confirmations from my side: 

1) Custody path: Please upload the archive to the Drive folder I maintain for level-change evidence: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3C-redwood-evidence. Set folder permissions to HR-only (Neha and me) for the intake stage. After upload, post a short note in the folder with timestamp and your initials — that will serve as the primary custody marker.

2) Redaction scope: Agree on PII/customer IDs/screenshots flagged by legal. If any transcript excerpts are critical to promotion narrative, include redacted excerpts (e.g., [REDACTED CUSTOMER]) rather than removing the entire file.

3) Audit/ SOC2: The redaction_log.csv you propose works; add a column for a small SHA256 hash of the original file so we can show tamper-evidence in an audit. HR/audit will accept that.

4) Committee timing: I can offer the following windows for Priya (2-hour): Mar 3 10:00–12:00 PT or Mar 4 13:00–15:00 PT. I note Aditya has a leadership offsite on Mar 2 so avoid that day.

I can help run a quick redaction pass on transcripts if you want — I have a small redaction script that tags probable PII and produces a diff for review.

—Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Director, People Ops (interim)
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-02-21T14:09:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Promotion packet: evidence custody, redaction, and committee timing

Diego / Lauren —

I'll take the first pass on redaction this afternoon. Operational notes: 

- Split delivery: Can you separate the package into (A) candidate-facing artifacts (resume, summary, consent) and (B) source artifacts (notebooks, PR links, raw transcripts)? Put A in the "committee packet" folder and B in an HR-only folder. That reduces the risk of accidental exposure.
- Redaction log: I'll append a "redacted_by" column and sign off with initials + timestamp after my pass.
- Evidence chain: After upload, I'll create a one-line entry in the Audit Sheet (Drive) and run the SHA256 script Lauren recommended to generate the tamper-evidence column.
- Conflicts: Quick flag — Aditya is on the committee rotation but is also listed as an indirect collaborator on two of the PRs in the evidence set. If that's a conflict we should route Priya to the secondary committee for that slot.

Diego — please upload the zip to the Drive folder and ping me when done; I'll start redactions and post the redaction_log.csv back into the HR-only folder.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
People Ops Partner
Redwood Inference

Date: 2027-02-22T15:47:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Promotion packet: evidence custody, redaction, and committee timing

Thanks everyone — clear path forward. A couple of action items I'm taking and confirmations: 

1) Intake and audit ID: Once Diego uploads to the Drive folder, I'll capture the intake as Case-ID RED-2027-0117 and create the audit entry (who/what/when). Please include the SHA256 hashes in the redaction_log.csv so audit can validate.

2) Candidate consent: We need a signed candidate_consent.pdf before committee review. Diego — please route the DocuSign link to Priya this afternoon: https://na.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=abcd-1234-hr-consent. The pop-up will email me a copy when completed.

3) Legal review: Looping in Susan Martinez (peopleops-legal) for confirmation that the proposed redaction scope (PII/customer IDs/screenshots) is adequate. Susan — quick call or reply is fine; Marissa will run the redaction and attach a redaction_log.csv with SHA256 and redacted_by columns.

4) Committee slot: We'll request Mar 3 10:00–12:00 PT initially. If Aditya's conflict persists he can be replaced for that slot; I will coordinate the backup slot.

5) Retention note: Per our retention policy, we keep the original raw evidence for 2 years in the HR secure retention store; redacted copies go to the committee packet and are retained for 7 years.

I'll wait for the Drive upload notice and the DocuSign completion before marking the case as Intake:Ready.

-Neha
Neha Kapoor
Head of People Operations (Comp & Talent Intake)
Redwood Inference
